verdict_rationale.structural: The frozen table eliminated dangling relationship and proposition endpoints in the raw Pass-2 proposal by construction, improving the specific SPEC-011 referential failure class. No accepted KnowledgeModel round-trip exists because grounding failed first.
verdict_rationale.grounding: Twenty-seven of twenty-eight proposed SOURCE items had exact unique quotes, but one fabricated/non-verbatim quote failed the unchanged evidence resolver. Pass 2 therefore failed closed and produced no trusted parent.
verdict_rationale.semantic: The rejected staged proposal improved reviewed proposal precision from the control mapping's 2/11 (18.18%) to 6/16 (37.5%), and fixed some known defects, but most reviewed links remained imprecise or unsupported. QFT/QED and tunneling endpoint defects persisted or changed form.
verdict_rationale.cost_complexity: Staging used two calls and 26,142 tokens versus 13,794 known tokens for the preserved control retry, added a frozen-symbol compiler surface, and still produced no accepted model. The structural gain does not yet justify the additional pass on this benchmark.
